subject.title: Add optional `name`/`label` field to group config entries

question: Should OpenClaw add one ignored metadata field to relevant channel group/channel config entries, and should the canonical key be name, label, or description?
rationale: This changes a public config contract across multiple channel schemas, generated metadata, docs, and agent config-writing behavior, so automation should wait for the durable field-name and scope decision.

options.title: Adopt name consistently
options.body: Add name?: string as ignored metadata across relevant group/channel entries, metadata generation, docs, and validation tests.

options.title: Use label or description
options.body: Choose a more explicitly display-only key and document its semantics across channels before implementation.

options.title: Decline metadata for now
options.body: Keep strict behavior-only entries and improve group-id discovery or config-tooling guidance instead.

recommendation.title: Adopt name consistently
recommendation.body: Add name?: string as ignored metadata across relevant group/channel entries, metadata generation, docs, and validation tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest current routing candidate from blame, recent docs/config history, and prior maintainer-facing review context for this public config-contract decision.
